productMatrix.scope: Product create/restore/save/pair-undo adapters, bounded recovery and original task authority with virtual Worker ports and clock; actual bounded runSearch, not full games or platform execution.

beforeAfter.scope: Deterministic limited-resource regression examples, not full-game strength ratings

realClock.scope: One reproducible 19-board fixed-five rescue scenario per actual production difficulty profile, monotonic real clock

desktop.scope: Version resources, PE integrity, complete packaged asset hashes, same AI Worker/core/session as web. This version was not manually played in a native window.

limitations: Finite heuristic search cannot guarantee that every five is breakable or every defence is found.
No new browser/native interactive UI session was required for the AI-only change; actual native Worker execution remains included in automated tests.
Existing P5.8 game win rates are historical and are not a P5.9 strength measurement.
